definition: native-authoring-v2 (2026-09-28), an upper bound: HoloScript-extension files under packages/, excluding descriptor twins; none is checked to parse or to be read by a build, loader or test
note: D.104 native-authoring ratchet baseline. The ratio is an upper bound: it counts HoloScript-extension files under packages/ except descriptor twins, and checks neither that they parse nor that a build, loader or test reads them. Only native and ratio are enforced; every other field is information. Coverage must rise or hold. Reseed only when it has GENUINELY risen (more native authoring), never to mask a regression. 2026-09-28: reseeded for native-authoring-v2. Descriptor twins ("Native .hsplus surface for" files their package does not ship) no longer count; 2,230 of the 2,247 were added on 2026-06-25 by 117 commits, 116 of which also rewrote this baseline, and a census on 2026-09-28 found nothing that loads or runs them. Under v1, which counted every HoloScript-extension file, this tree read 86.31%.
